summary: New AI Gateway models, expanded SDK adapters, and deployment enhancements; several promotional offers and older features are no longer listed.

key_changes.title: GLM 5.3 now available on AI Gateway
key_changes.impact: Adds a powerful new model to the AI Gateway, enabling developers to use GLM-5.3 with a single API key and no platform fee.
key_changes.explanation: Provides an additional high‑performance model for Vercel AI Gateway users, expanding the range of available AI services.

key_changes.title: Chat SDK adds Instagram adapter
key_changes.impact: Extends the Chat SDK to support Instagram Direct Messages, allowing bot developers to interact with Instagram users directly.
key_changes.explanation: Enables building DM bots with media, quick replies, reactions, and story replies on Instagram.

key_changes.title: Vercel for Platforms can now deploy from your users' GitHub repositories
key_changes.impact: Simplifies deployment for platform builders by allowing short‑lived GitHub tokens to fetch source code securely.
key_changes.explanation: Users can deploy directly from their GitHub repos without storing tokens on the deployment.

key_changes.title: GLM 5.2 free for eve agents through August 27 via Blackbox on AI Gateway

key_changes.explanation: The entry for the free GLM‑5.2 promotion is absent from the current extraction.
